build_Pipeline: build a LangGraph stream pipeline instance with configurable API URL for Open WebUI integration
create_Valves: create a Valves configuration model with LangGraph API URL from environment variables
run_pipe: run the pipe method to stream LangGraph responses from a user message via SSE
review_on_startup: review the on_startup hook that logs the pipeline name when the server starts
review_on_shutdown: review the on_shutdown hook that logs the pipeline name when the server shuts down
